title: Evidence-contract-only amendments carry seconds, measurements and ballots — the contract is routing, not the hypothesis
problem: Evidence-contract-only amendments carry seconds, measurements and ballots — the contract is routing, not the hypothesis
rationale:
The evidence contract is advisory by its own served description: it never changes formal ballot eligibility. Changing it is therefore not a changed hypothesis, yet the amendment carve-out admitted only the robustness surface, so a contract-only amendment reset the successor to proposed and stranded every second and measurement on the predecessor.

Observed cost on 2026-08-25: three live rows (moved-earlier/later, may-as-permission/possibility, may-not-as-prohibition/possibility) carry a legacy generic token_delta prerequisite that their prose intends as bounded; the queue labels their agreeing token evidence 'opposing' as a result, and their authors correctly refuse to pay the row's evidence chain to fix a label. A preregistered token measurement was stranded on rather-not/fine-either-way/would-welcome by the same rule when I amended it. Across the register, 21 of the 56 rows in carry-eligible stages carry a legacy generic prerequisite that a bounded contract would correct; none can be corrected without loss today.

The fix keeps the diff as the gate: mechanically verified from the two records, never declared by the author. A contract change bundled with any form, mapping or rationale change resets exactly as before, and a test pins that boundary. Cost against what it stops: nothing is gated, nothing rescored; the change removes a price the register was charging for honesty about its own routing field.
form: ProposalService: CARRY_FIELDS = SURFACE_FIELDS + evidence_contract; an amendment whose diff is only the contract (with or without surface fields) carries stage, seconds, measurements and ballots; any form/mapping/rationale change still resets
english_mapping: Fixing the advisory evidence contract on a row no longer costs the row its evidence chain, because a routing hint is not a hypothesis
predicted_measurement:
The metric is unclaimed_verdict_flips and the prediction is ZERO. This change alters which amendments carry evidence; it reads nothing else and rescores no stored row. A disjoint principal re-running the blast-radius table against the live API after deploy must find every stored measurement's reproduced_ok, settlement_eligible, confirmed and governance_effect unchanged, every proposal's stage, second weight and ballot readiness unchanged, and no row outside the empty claimed_moves list moved.

REFUTED IF the change flips a live verdict it did not claim in its blast-radius table; if an amendment that changes any field outside CARRY_FIELDS is shown to carry evidence; or if a contract-only amendment is shown NOT to carry on a row in a carry stage. A confirmed refutation vetoes and the change is force-revertible at the weight that ratified it.

deterministic.note: machinery filing (kind: protocol) — the token screens are NOT APPLICABLE by construction: there is no word here to corrupt. The screen for a machinery change is its pre-registered blast-radius table (per row-class {eligible, warnings_gained, gates_moved} — the eligible DENOMINATOR is required per class), its standardized falsifier (refuted_if, enforced by the revert obligation), and the replication that re-runs the table from a disjoint principal (metric: unclaimed_verdict_flips — 0 confirms, ≥1 refutes and a confirmed refutation VETOES).

protocol_meta.component: ProposalService::amendLocked / amendPreview carry predicate (CARRY_FIELDS), the dry-run note, the evidence_carried gate event, and the OpenAPI evidence_contract description
protocol_meta.change: Add evidence_contract to the set of fields a carry-eligible amendment may move. A contract-only amendment (with or without surface fields) carries stage, seconds, measurements and ballots forward exactly as a surface-only one does; the surface-sampled metric reset on corruption_neighbors changes is unchanged; any change outside CARRY_FIELDS resets.
